About me

A data analyst who leads from the front

I studied data science because I like finding the story in messy information. Now I lead the people who help me find it.

At Rarely Heard Voices, a London retail advisory firm, I've grown from intern to researcher in two years. My work has three parts. I lead the data team that collects and analyses market data and builds dashboards for client decisions. I support business development, tracking introductions between brands and keeping deals moving. And I help run invitation-only events for retail leaders in London and New York. Along the way I present to clients, take part in hiring and contribute to the discussions where decisions get made.

I bring creative and logical thinking to a problem, and I'm not afraid to hold an opinion. If the data supports a view, I'll make the case for it clearly.

Scraping, collecting, cleaning and analysing data, then building dashboards people actually use.

Hiring, training, monitoring and leading a team of several members. I know how to work hard myself, and how to get the work done through others.

I lead on-screen client meetings, presenting dashboards, explaining data and discussing ways to work together. I also write reports, one-pagers and itineraries that give busy people what they need in a few minutes. I've also spoken to more than 100 students as a guest speaker.

I contribute to decision-making discussions with a clear, data-backed point of view.

Away from work: music, games and sports.
